name: taxi-meter
description: A taxi meter in the status line: the session's cost ticks up live as tokens burn.

language.title: Language
language.description: Meter labels: en (FOR HIRE/HIRED/WAITING) or zh (空车/载客/等候)

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Show the fare in USD or CNY

cnyRate.title: CNY per USD
cnyRate.description: Exchange rate used when currency is CNY

sound.title: Ka-ching
sound.description: Play a ka-ching when the fare crosses a milestone ($1, $2, $5, $10 ...)

bigTripUsd.title: Big trip toast (USD)
bigTripUsd.description: Toast a receipt when one turn costs at least this much

budgetUsd.title: Budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Default fare limit per session; 0 for none. /taxi budget changes it for this session

planUsd.title: Subscription (USD/month)
planUsd.description: Your Claude subscription's monthly price; the meter then shows how many times over this month's usage pays it back. 0 for API billing
